fusions.name: Bare-Knuckle Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a punch of raw force that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Unbound Pound
fusions.desc: Slams a wave of raw arcana that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores their resistances.

fusions.name: Arcane Arm-Span
fusions.desc: Your attacks and spells reach 54% further for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Charged Fist
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
